summary: P2 fixed red-first; VM gate green; five overlay categories remain at zero and all 83 unrelated corpus failures are unchanged.
body:
Accepted the finding; none rejected. Native transition mapping lacked overlay-preservation information and incorrectly reported retained transitions as lost.

Changed files:

- [import.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import.rs:207): records transitions fully preserved in emitted overlays.
- [transition.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/transition.rs:5): checks preservation and skips native mapping and its warnings.
- [group.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/group.rs:15): passes preservation information through nested mapping.
- [tests.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/src/scene/import/tests.rs:904): adds four regression tests.

A transition is preserved only when one emitted overlay contains every endpoint and its definition: the explicit transition node, or the enclosing sequence for an automatic transition. Partial preservation and separate overlays retain existing native handling and warnings. Timing remains unchanged; work stays within the existing transition budget.

Semantics follow XSD [transitionType](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd:4794), [sequenceType](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/fixoverlay/crates/interchange/schema/sr-core/scene-render.xsd:4586), and scene-render `sr-eval/src/program.rs::{transitions, place_sequence}`. No unresolved ambiguity or newly borrowed renderer code.

Public API unchanged:

```rust
pub fn import(bytes: &[u8], opts: &ImportOptions)
    -> Result<(Imported, Vec<Overlay>, Report)>;
```

TDD evidence: [red log](/tmp/fixoverlay-round5-red.log) → [green log](/tmp/fixoverlay-round5-green.log).

| Test | Red | Green |
|---|---|---|
| scene_import_round5_overlay_transition_report | Failed: false “Unmapped transition: no native endpoint clip was retained” warning | Passed |
| scene_import_round5_overlay_sequence_transition_report | Failed: same false warning | Passed |
| scene_import_round5_partial_overlay_transition_keeps_native_report | Passed as control | Passed |
| scene_import_round5_separate_overlays_transition_keeps_native_report | Passed as control | Passed |

[Full VM gate](/tmp/fixoverlay-round5-gate.log): formatting and Clippy passed; **366 tests passed, zero failed, three existing ignores**; **51 Wasm crates passed**.

[Pinned corpus](/tmp/fixoverlay-round5-corpus.log), compared with the [fresh baseline](/tmp/fixoverlay-round5-baseline.log):

- external-expression, generated-id, material-override, voxel-palette, geodesic-camera: **0 → 0** each.
- Unrelated fractional-depth: **11 → 11**; linked-audio: **72 → 72**.
- All **83 failure records match exactly**, including multiplicity, case, mode, stage, and message. [Comparison](/tmp/fixoverlay-round5-comparison.json).
- Totals unchanged: 1,343 cases, 2,020 imports/exports/oracle checks, and 4,040 successful re-imports. The corpus command exits 101 solely for those existing unrelated failures.

Changes remain **uncommitted on 12003949**. Earlier fixes, the provenance header, ATTRIBUTION.md, corpus harness, and SAMPLE_REGRESSION are unchanged. Task completed; all locks released.
